If you follow the scripture, you will have a sweet home. Marriage is looking out for the other person's interest. A sweet marriage starts by making good decisions. 
Good Decisions in Marriage
1. Make a decision that your home will be a haven, where people run back for peace, love, attention, and care. 
2. Your home should be Christ-centered. Jesus must be the Lord of your home. 
3. Look at what the Bible says about marriage and a godly family. 
4. Live by the Holy Spirit and not the flesh. 
By these decisions, you set your marriage on a firm foundation that cannot be moved. Make Jesus the centre of your values and decisions, knowing that you are his ambassador on earth. Jeremiah 29:11.
God's plan is that the home will be the place where his plan is revealed. In the family, the man creates the atmosphere where people experience the peace of God. Your home is not supposed to be a war zone. 
In God's plan, man is supposed to bring this Scripture to being. You are supposed to be a replica of God to your children.
In a God-centered marriage, men and women are equal. The female was already in the man before she was created. They are equal in worth before God. Galatians 3:28. 
A key is not more important than a padlock and vice-versa, and soup was not made to be eaten alone. Man and woman were created to be interdependent; one can't survive without the other. The wife makes the home flow.

description:
Genesis 2:18-25; Matthew 19:3-9; Ephesians 5:21-31; Phillipians 2:1-4
If you follow the scripture, you will have a sweet home. Marriage is looking out for the other person's interest. A sweet marriage starts by making good decisions. 
Good Decisions in Marriage
1. Make a decision that your home will be a haven, where people run back for peace, love, attention, and care. 
2. Your home should be Christ-centered. Jesus must be the Lord of your home. 
3. Look at what the Bible says about marriage and a godly family. 
4. Live by the Holy Spirit and not the flesh. 
By these decisions, you set your marriage on a firm foundation that cannot be moved. Make Jesus the centre of your values and decisions, knowing that you are his ambassador on earth. Jeremiah 29:11.
God's plan is that the home will be the place where his plan is revealed. In the family, the man creates the atmosphere where people experience the peace of God. Your home is not supposed to be a war zone. 
In God's plan, man is supposed to bring this Scripture to being. You are supposed to be a replica of God to your children.
In a God-centered marriage, men and women are equal. The female was already in the man before she was created. They are equal in worth before God. Galatians 3:28. 
A key is not more important than a padlock and vice-versa, and soup was not made to be eaten alone. Man and woman were created to be interdependent; one can't survive without the other. The wife makes the home flow.

title: 2020 Lexus RX350 Review // Some updates for 2020
description:
#LexusRX
#Lexus
#RX350
The 2020 Lexus RX350 gets some nice updates to soften the look and to add more connectivity.New for 2020, Lexus gives the RX series a sleeker new look, starting with a redefined front grille, redesigned LED headlights and rear LED taillights plus new styled wheel. The biggest change up front is a softer, less sharp front design, most noticeable at the bottom corners of the front spoiler where the large air inlets and fog lights rest. What is still here is the sharp character line that runs down the side. Updated on all models is a new touchscreen and Lexus Remote touchpad plus two extra USB outlets in the rear.  The standard Lexus Display Audio is an 8” touchscreen  but there is an available 12.3-inch high resolution split-screen touchscreen, plus  six USB ports throughout the RX. Under the hood is a carried over 295hp 3.5L V6 engine with an eight-speed automatic plus standard Dynamic Torque Control AWD and sequential shift .The 2020 Lexus RX 350 comes with  the Lexus Premium Package. This model features a new 18” alloy wheel design, cargo area lamp with new LED source, heated and ventilated front row seats, heated second row seats,  Lexus Smart Key System with Push Button Start, a power rear door  rain-sensing wipers and LED headlamps. The F SPORT Series 2 gets new features for 2020, including a 12.3” full colour touchscreen, LED fog lamps, and Lexus Navigation with Remote. The Sport-L-shaped premium headlamps, cornering lamps and premium LED rear combination lamps. F SPORT models get  Adaptive Variable Suspension and F SPORT-styled leather seating, leather steering wheel with paddle shifters, shift knob, meters, scuff plates, front grille and 20” alloy wheels. The F SPORT Series 3,  New for this year, this model includes the kick sensor power back door. Other upgrades  include a panoramic glass roof, panoramic view monitor, power folding rear seats, a head-up display, wireless charging system for compatible personal electronics, and a 15 speaker Mark Levinson Audio system.

title: 2020 Lexus RX 350 Road Test & Review vs. The 2020 Acura MDX
description:
Looking for a helpful video review of the 2020 RX 350 vs. the 2020 Acura MDX? This is it. Join car enthusiast Bradley Hasemeyer for an informative and entertaining head-to-head vehicle matchup between these two leading luxury SUVs.

We all want premium styling, great standard features and satisfying driving experiences. But with so many luxury SUVs offering seemingly similar qualities, differentiating between them can be challenging. This engaging video sheds light on the key differences between the Lexus RX 350 and Acura MDX.

How does the Precision Concept-inspired styling of the Acura 3-row SUV compare to the aggressive design of the Lexus SUV? We’ll review exteriors from front grilles to exhaust outlets. How do the Jewel Eye® LED headlights and luxurious cockpit in the MDX compare to their counterparts in the RX 350? We'll review stylistic and interior choices for both. Which SUV makes longer trips easier, especially for large families? We’ll drive the Acura MDX and Lexus RX 350 to compare horsepower, steering, handling, road comfort and more. Not only will you discover key technologies that make the MDX a great midsize luxury SUV to drive like its 9 speed automatic transmission, paddle shifters and available Super Handling All Wheel Drive™, you’ll also learn about helpful features on the MDX that make it easy to accommodate passengers.

All in all, the 2020 Lexus RX 350 and the 2020 Acura MDX are both great SUVs from desirable luxury car brands. But only one should be at the top of your wish list. Watch this video review comparison now to see why the MDX is the best SUV in 2020 for the money.
This video was filmed on December 11-12, 2018 in Irvine, California (driving scenes) and Honda Studio 540 in Torrance, California (in-car reviews) and includes the 2019 Acura MDX, the 2019 Lexus RX 350, and the 2019 Acura MDX A-Spec®.

Treard Cutting Problem
description:
If your sewing machine is cutting the thread while sewing, here are some possible causes and solutions:

1. Thread Tension Too High

Issue: If the upper thread tension is too tight, the thread may snap.

Solution: Loosen the upper thread tension by adjusting the tension dial to a lower number.


2. Incorrect Threading

Issue: If the thread is not threaded properly, it may get stuck and break.

Solution: Rethread the upper thread and bobbin correctly, following the machine’s manual.


3. Poor-Quality or Old Thread

Issue: Old, weak, or low-quality thread can break easily.

Solution: Use high-quality polyester or cotton thread suitable for your fabric.


4. Damaged or Incorrect Needle

Issue: A bent, dull, or incorrect needle can cause the thread to snap.

Solution: Replace the needle with a new one suited for your fabric type.


5. Bobbin Case Issues

Issue: A damaged or incorrectly placed bobbin case can cause the thread to break.

Solution: Check if the bobbin is inserted correctly and that there is no damage to the case.


6. Dirty or Jammed Machine

Issue: Dust, lint, or debris in the tension discs or bobbin area can affect thread movement.

Solution: Clean your machine thoroughly, especially around the tension discs and bobbin case.


7. Thread Getting Caught

Issue: The thread may get stuck in the spool or tension discs.

Solution: Ensure the spool moves freely and is not caught on the spool pin.


8. Wrong Presser Foot Pressure

Issue: Too much pressure can cause excess tension on the thread.

Solution: Adjust the presser foot pressure according to your fabric thickness.

description:
Vanguard is the most effective vehicle ever created for participating in the fruits of American capitalism. Today it’s the single largest equity owner of the majority of corporations in the S&P 500, on behalf of 50 million clients (including, likely, many of you). And yet Vanguard itself is essentially a communist organization — it has no shareholders, makes no profits, and operates more like REI than Fidelity. If you own a Vanguard fund, you own a piece of the firm itself. Any excess margin instead gets returned to clients in the form of lower fees, which since 1975 have added up to roughly five hundred billion dollars transferred out of Wall Street managers’ pockets and into retail investors’ savings accounts. title: Vanguard Founder Jack Bogle's '90s Interview Shows His Investing Philosophy
description:
Vanguard founder Jack Bogle was famous for making investing accessible to the everyday person through index funds – funds that match a market barometer like the S&P 500. His message was simple: why waste money on expensive fees and commissions for complex funds when market barometers often outperform them? That message remained remarkably consistent throughout his career.

Jack Bogle needed hefty amounts of brainpower and market know-how to put together the first index fund. But for investors wanting to cash in on his idea, it's become pretty easy.

In 1975, the founder of Vanguard Group, who died Wednesday, was able to turn a long-held belief into reality, namely that it was far more profitable to follow the market than fight it. Most mutual fund managers who picked stocks couldn't keep up with basic benchmarks like the S&P 500, much less beat them, he found.

So he turned his thoughts into action, putting together the first fund that simply followed the S&P 500, minus a small management cost that was much cheaper than the active funds of the day.

Timestamps:

0:00 - John Bogle's key 10 rules of investing are : 

0:16 - 1. Reversion to the mean: What's hot today isn't likely to be hot tomorrow.

2:51 - 2. Time is your friend: Let the miracle of compound interest work for you.

5:15 - 3. Buy right and hold tight: Stick to the plan no matter how greedy or scared you become.

6:09 - 4. Have realistic expectations: You are unlikely to get rich quickly. 

7:09 - 5. Forget the needle, buy the haystack: Buy broad-based index or exchange-traded funds and you can cut stock risk, style risk, and manager risk. 

7:53 - 6. Minimize the “croupier’s” take: Minimize fees by investing in low-cost funds. This increases your return.

8:39 - 7. There’s no escaping risk: There’s no wealth without risk.

12:47 - 8. Don’t fight the last war: What worked in the past is no predictor of what will work in future. 

14:51 - 9. The hedgehog beats the fox: Foxes represent the financial institutions that charge far too much for their artful, complicated advice. A hedgehog does one thing when threatened — he curls up into a spiny ball. Simple, but effective, like an index fund. 

16:46 - 10. Stay the course: The secret to successful investing isn’t forecasting or good stock picking. It is about making a plan, sticking to it, and eliminating unnecessary risks.

An index fund is a collection of different companies on a list you can put your money into that allows you to own portions to each of those companies within one purchase. title: Jack Bogle on Index Funds, Vanguard, and Investing Advice
description:
Jack Bogle transformed the investment management industry. Over a career lasting nearly half a century, Bogle was a crusader for individual investors, working to bring the interests of asset managers in line with those of their investment clients. 

In 1975, Bogle founded the Vanguard Group, structuring the business as a mutual company, meaning that Vanguard is owned by the funds it manages and, as a result, the funds' investors. A year later, Bogle and Vanguard introduced the first ever index mutual fund available to the general public, aiming to track the performance of the broader market while charging the lowest fees possible. At first, many in the investment industry snickered at Vanguard's new index funds, but over time Bogle's idea took hold. While maintaining some of the lowest fees in the business, Vanguard has grown its assets under management from $1.8 billion at its founding to $5.3 trillion as of September 30, 2018, making Vanguard the second largest asset manager in the world.

Despite Vanguard's incredible success, Bogle didn't become fantastically rich. Instead, Jack passed on as much savings as possible to Vanguard investors, bringing fees for his funds to razor-thin levels (and dragging the rest of the fund market with him). As a result, Bogle helped all investors get better returns on their retirement savings, drastically reducing underperformance caused by high management fees. As Bogle said in 2012, "My ideas are very simple. In investing, you get what you don't pay for."

All investors are indebted to Jack Bogle for his efforts over 40+ years to make the investment industry better serve the interests of individuals. As we remember Bogle's life and his contributions, we hope you'll enjoy this conversation between Bogle and Motley Fool Motley Fool CEO Tom Gardner recorded in 2016.

title: Vanguard CEO Salim Ramji in Conversation with Christine Benz
description:
Vanguard CEO Salim Ramji in Conversation with Christine Benz

What happens when the first current CEO of Vanguard sits down in front of a room full of Bogleheads and takes their questions—uncensored—on service failures, AI, private equity, and even crypto? In this keynote interview from the Bogleheads 2025 Conference, Vanguard CEO Salim Ramji joins Christine Benz for a candid, wide-ranging conversation about how he sees John C. Bogle’s legacy today and where Vanguard is headed next.

Ramji reflects on what makes Vanguard structurally different—its client-owned mutual structure—and why he believes “cost matters” remains the core principle that drives everything else. He explains what it was like to come into Vanguard from the outside, how seriously he takes the Bogleheads community (“our owners”), and why he sees the firm’s purpose and mission as very much alive, not just corporate nostalgia.

The discussion then moves directly into the hard questions many investors are asking: How does Vanguard assess its recent customer service performance, and what concrete initiatives are underway to enhance service quality for investors? Ramji walks through the painful combination of rapid growth, legacy mainframe systems, and underinvestment, and outlines specific steps underway—modernizing the tech stack to the cloud, rebuilding the secure site, restoring more personalized service (including a flagship-like relationship model), and tightening fraud and cybersecurity defenses. He also addresses concerns about account fraud, consolidation risk, and why vigilance from both Vanguard and its clients is critical.

Finally, Ramji tackles the strategic issues: the role of AI in portfolio management and digital advice, why bonds and high-quality fixed income are central to the next decade, Vanguard’s push into active fixed income at low cost, how they’re cautiously exploring private credit and private equity (without abandoning low-fee discipline), and why Vanguard still views crypto and even gold as speculation rather than investment. Throughout, he emphasizes a simple through-line: stay anchored in Bogle’s principles—low cost, simplicity, client ownership—while using new tools like AI and modern technology to deliver better, more accessible service and advice to millions of investors.

title: QNET Success Stories | V Partner Kavita Sugandh
description:
Meet V Partner Kavita Sugandh, a true success story of determination and hard work. Coming from a lower middle-class family supported by her father’s small business, she had to work her way up in the corporate world. But even after starting and growing her own HR consultancy, she quickly realised that wanted more from life. 
 
When she was introduced to QNET, things started to change. At first, she was skeptical, but after attending her first V-Convention, her eyes were opened to the business's potential. She decided to start QNET full-time, even though it wasn't easy to build her network; while many were attracted to the rewards of the business, only some were willing to do the hard work required. She persevered and found people who shared her vision and excitement for direct selling and its future.
 
VP Kavita Sugandh's success story with QNET is truly remarkable and inspiring. Through consistency and perseverance, she reached big goals and quickly climbed the sales ranks at QNET. When asked about what keeps her motivated, she credits her desire to be able to afford the best of the best for herself and her family. She also credits QNET products as some of the best and essential to her daily life. 
 
Along her journey, VP Kavita has learned many valuable lessons. The most important is to avoid getting stuck in past successes and failures as it stifles growth. The second is that the only way to be relevant is to help others grow. To those new to the business, she advises being grateful for the journey and the ups and downs because that means you're alive, and that only makes success more exciting and fulfilling.

title: The Woman Who Wrote a Hymn — And Changed America #JuliaWardHowe #CivilWar
description:
In 1861, a woman visited a Union Army camp. She heard soldiers singing — and had no idea she was about to change history.

She heard them sing about a man named John Brown — and thought: "I can write better words." That night, she woke up with the poem in her mind.

She wrote: "Mine eyes have seen the glory of the coming of the Lord — He is trampling out the vintage where the grapes of wrath are stored."

She sold the poem for $5. It became the anthem of the Union Army. And it still inspires Americans today.

The Hymn That Inspired America - A Glenn Rawson Story
description:
One winter afternoon in 1831, a 22-year-old seminary student sat in his room turning the pages of a book of German hymns.

One melody caught his attention.

Without planning it, he picked up a scrap of paper and, in less than thirty minutes, wrote words that would stir the hearts of millions of Americans for generations.

He later said it came as "a sudden inspiration."

The song would become America's unofficial national anthem for a century, inspiring schoolchildren, soldiers, congregations, and patriots alike.

Sometimes the Lord accomplishes remarkable things in quiet moments, through willing hearts, with nothing more than a simple impression and the courage to act upon it.

👉 Listen to more stories
 www.GlennRawsonStories.com
🎵 Music Featured
 My country Tis of Thee (Piano Solo arrangement) by Jason Tonioli
Sheet Music at: www.Tonioli.com

How "My Country Tis of Thee" was written and composed:

One winter day in February 1831, 22-year-old Samuel was sitting in his room at the Andover Theological Seminary in Massachusetts, looking over a collection of German hymns that had been given him by the famed organist and composer, Lowell Mason. Lowell intended to publish a collection of hymns and wondered if Samuel could possibly translate them and find something of use for children’s choirs. Lowell admitted that he could not read the hymns, but said they contained good music. 

He asked Samuel to “turn over the leaves” and give him a translation or imitation
that he could then use.

He even gave Samuel the freedom to create an original song and share it with him. Samuel thumbed through the collection and came across a song in German titled, “God Bless Our Native Land”. Samuel later wrote: “I instantly felt the impulse to write a patriotic hymn of my own, adapted to the tune. Picking up a scrap of wastepaper which lay near me, I wrote at
once, probably within half an hour, the hymn… as it is now known everywhere. The whole hymn stands today as it stood on the bit of waste paper.”

What Samuel likely did not know was that the same tune had been used before — not only in Germany, but in England to the words of “God Save the King” — and even for various uses in America. The tune was well-used. Samuel gave his composition to Lowell Mason, and was most pleased to hear it sung for the first time on July 4, 1831 by a children’s choir at the Park Street Church in Boston.

Samuel later wrote of that song:
“I had no thought of writing a national hymn; had I done so, I should probably have taken more pains to criticize and to perfect it. It went from me, however, and the people took it up…. I noticed that the German words were patriotic, but I did not read them through, and the hymn is in no sense a translation. It was the result of a sudden inspiration, quickly thrown off, and,
to my surprise, at once adopted.”

Written in sight of the Old North Church in Boston, and just at sunset, Samuel —
Dr. Samuel Francis Smith — turned a German song, “God Bless Our Native Land”, into “My Country, ‘Tis of Thee.” 

It would go on to become the unofficial anthem of the United States of America until 1931, and remains one of the most popular songs in American history.  

There is one more story of relevant note. I quote David Hein: “In May of 1887, an elderly
tourist was sitting in the gallery of the Board of Trade in Chicago, Illinois, quietly observing all the commotion of buying and selling. Someone on the floor recognized him and pointed him out to others, whereupon the clamor quickly subsided as traders ceased their dealing to pay tribute to the old man. Presently out of the wheat pit came the sound of familiar words: 

My country,’tis of thee,
Sweet land of liberty.
Of thee I sing;

Land where my fathers died,
Land of the pilgrims’ pride,
From every mountainside
Let freedom ring.

My native country, thee,
Land of the noble free,
Thy name I love;

I love thy rocks and rills.
Thy woods and templed hills;
My heart with rapture thrills
Like that above. 

Then the men gave their visitor a tumultuous cheer. The Secretary of the Board escorted him to the floor, where all the members flocked around him, reaching out eagerly to shake the hand of the 79-year-old author of ‘America’. Then, removing their hats, they sang the rest of the hymn.

Let music swell the breeze, 
And ring from all the trees 
Sweet freedom’s song;
Let mortal tongues awake,
Let all that breathe partake,
Let rocks their silence break,
The sound prolong. 

Our fathers’ God, to thee,
Author of liberty,
To thee we sing;

Long may our land be bright
With freedom’s holy light;
Protect us by thy might,
The sound prolong.
Great God, our King.”

The Almighty wanted this hymn written and gave it in a moment to a talented
young Baptist. How many souls has it stirred in spiritual and patriotic fervor since
then? I wonder today how many could still sing it from memory.

description:
드디어 터졌다! 시청 지속 시간 및 침샘 자극 위꼴 지표 최고점 돌파 치트키 세트 등판! 갓벽한 고기 조합으로 전국의 야식 욕구를 제대로 자극하는 먹짱의 전율 돋는 폭풍 흡입 빌드업!
그러나 진짜 전국의 시청자들을 빵 터지게 만든 역대급 반전의 절정은, 갈비와 밥, 고추냉이 삼합을 가득 넣고 행복해하는 쯔양의 속도에 맞춰 '섹시야마' 추성훈이 불꽃 피지컬로 고기를 조달하는 순간 폭발합니다 ㅋㅋㅋ
먹짱의 무시무시한 소화 속도를 도저히 따라잡지 못해 야속하게 타오르는 화로를 쳐다보며 안절부절못하는 추성훈과, 고기가 끊기지 않게 은밀한 압박을 넣는 권력미 넘치는 쯔양의 살벌한 먹방 모먼트 ㅋㅋㅋ
굽는 자와 먹는 자의 완벽한 서열 재정립과 보는 내내 침이 꼴깍 넘어가는 고기 파티의 정교한 숏폼 레이아웃은 알고리즘 트렌드 마스터피스 그 자체입니다 ✨🥩
"와... 처음에 밥 위에 갈비 올리고 와사비 얹을 때 진심 모니터 뜯어먹을 뻔했다 ㅋㅋㅋ 그와중에 추성훈 고기 태울까 봐 덜덜 떨면서 열심히 굽는데 쯔양 먹는 속도가 광속이라 화로가 야속하다는 말 개웃기네 ㅠㅠ 다음 고기 폭격 씬 현기증 나니까 빨리 가져와요 배고파요"라며 전국의 수많은 유저들이 폭발적인 야식 본능과 대리 만족 서사를 인증한 웰메이드 예능 바이브 ㅋㅋㅋ
링 위에서는 무적이었던 거구가 도리어 거대한 식욕의 거인 앞에 완벽한 고기 굽기 조력자로 마주하게 되는 통쾌한 역할 반전의 실루엣과, 위장을 구원하기 위해 차갑게 구워지는 고기들의 살벌한 비주얼 ㅋㅋㅋ 과연 고기 공급 부족 사태에 직면한 추성훈은 먹짱 쯔양의 자비 없는 먹방 철퇴 앞에 얼마나 더 처절하게 집게를 휘두르게 될까요?
2026년 현재 단순한 대식을 넘어, 우리 사회의 가장 원초적인 미각 카타르시스와 그 뒤에 숨은 스타들의 반전 케미를 거대한 재미의 철퇴로 바로 세우는 웰메이드 예능의 완벽한 흥행 공식!
대한민국 예능 한복판에 침투한 가장 맛있고 유쾌한 먹방의 사슬을 단숨에 조각내 굶주린 시청자들을 완벽하게 구원해 낼 최강 조합의 본격적인 갈비 사냥 전말을 지금 바로 예능 [쯔양몇끼] 5화에서 직접 확인해 보세요! 🇰🇷
지금 바로 감상하러 가기! 🔥🎬

description:
드디어 터졌다! 시청 지속 시간 및 유저 침샘 지표 최고점 돌파 치트키 세트 등판! 보는 순간 다이어트 강제 해제시키고 즉석밥 돌리게 만드는 역대급 비빔 비주얼의 오프닝 빌드업!
그러나 진짜 전국의 시청자들을 야식 증후군에 걸리게 만든 역대급 비주얼 카타르시스의 절정은, 요리의 풍미를 단숨에 수직 상승시키는 달큰 짭짤한 특제 소스가 아낌없이 투하되는 순간 폭발합니다 ㅋㅋㅋ
밥알과 고기 고명 사이사이로 부드럽게 스며들며 흐르는 소스의 영롱한 자태 ㅋㅋㅋ 맛의 정점을 찍어버릴 이 영리한 '비빌병기'의 등장에 "비비는 건 한국인의 본능"이라며 DNA가 시키는 대로 거대한 숟가락을 맹렬하게 회전시키는 대식가 요정 쯔양의 소름 돋는 손기술 모먼트 ㅋㅋㅋ
온갖 고명과 단짠 소스가 완벽한 황금 비율로 비벼져 침샘을 자극하는 한 그릇을 완성하고, 그걸 그대로 입안 가득 밀어 넣으며 세상에서 가장 행복한 리액션을 보여주는 쯔양과 크루들의 환상적인 먹방 텐션은 숏폼 알고리즘 트렌드 마스터피스 그 자체입니다 ✨🏫
"와... 소스 부어질 때 점성 흐르는 거 보고 진심 침 고여서 미치는 줄 알았다 ㅋㅋㅋ 한국인은 저 소스 비주얼 보면 숟가락 들고 비비는 게 국룰이지;; 쯔양 비비는 속도랑 한입 크기 보는데 대리만족 장난 아니다 ㅠㅠ 오늘 야식은 무조건 덮밥으로 간다"라며 전국의 수많은 유저들이 폭발적인 위장 테러와 역대급 비주얼 먹방을 인증한 웰메이드 예능 바이브 ㅋㅋㅋ
아늑한 조명 아래 그릇을 가득 채우는 달콤한 특제 소스의 향기와, 한계를 모르는 대식가 요정들의 거침없는 폭풍 흡입 실루엣 ㅋㅋㅋ 과연 상상을 초월하는 마성의 소스를 만나 꿀맛으로 진화한 이 역대급 비빌병기 메뉴 앞에, 쯔양은 어떤 상상 초월의 최종 그릇 스코어를 기록하게 될까요?
2026년 현재 단순한 많이 먹기를 넘어, 유저들의 본능을 자극하는 최고의 소스와 침샘을 터뜨리는 K-비빔의 매력으로 무한 도파민을 선사하는 웰메이드 예능의 완벽한 흥행 공식!
대한민국 전역의 식욕을 자극하며 아침부터 밤까지 비빔 광기를 가동할 최강 먹방 크루들의 본격적인 소스 파티 전말을 지금 바로 예능 [쯔양몇끼]에서 직접 확인해 보세요! 🇰🇷

- St. Peter’s Basilica, Pentecost Sunday - Pope Leo XIV, 2026

The Catholic Church has long stood as one of the world’s most enduring witnesses to beauty, truth, and transcendence, and nowhere is this more evident than in its music and in the wisdom of its Doctors. Across centuries, the Church has woven together faith and art in a way that lifts the human spirit beyond the ordinary. Its musical tradition—whether the solemn purity of Gregorian chant, the soaring polyphony of Palestrina, or the majestic compositions that filled cathedrals during the Baroque era—has always aimed at something higher than entertainment. These melodies were crafted to draw the soul toward contemplation, to echo the mystery of the divine, and to remind believers that worship is not merely spoken but sung, resonating through the very architecture of sacred spaces. The Church’s music became a universal language, capable of uniting people across cultures and eras in a shared sense of awe.
Alongside this musical heritage stands the intellectual and spiritual brilliance of the Doctors of the Church, whose teachings continue to shape Christian thought. Figures like St. Augustine, with his profound reflections on grace and the restless human heart, or St. Thomas Aquinas, whose synthesis of faith and reason remains unmatched, offer a depth that still challenges and inspires. St. Teresa of Ávila and St. John of the Cross revealed the heights and depths of the mystical life, while St. Athanasius and St. Basil defended the core truths of the faith with courage and clarity. Each Doctor contributed a unique voice, much like the varied harmonies in sacred music, yet all pointed toward the same divine mystery. Their writings, prayers, and insights form a kind of spiritual symphony—one that continues to guide the Church and illuminate the path for believers seeking wisdom.
Together, the Church’s music and its Doctors reveal a tradition that is not static but alive, continually inviting humanity into a deeper encounter with the sacred. They show that glory is not found in power or prestige but in the persistent pursuit of truth, beauty, and holiness.

title: Catholic Psalm Chants | Monastic Hymns & Canticles for Prayer
description:
Listen on all digital platforms: https://found.ee/monacidicamaldoli_cantisalmodici

This collection of Catholic Psalm Chants presents a tradition of monastic prayer rooted in the Psalms, biblical canticles, and the daily rhythm of the Liturgy of the Hours. Performed in a simple and contemplative style inspired by the ancient heritage of Gregorian chant, these melodies invite the listener into the timeless spirituality of the Christian monastic tradition.

For centuries, the Book of Psalms has formed the heart of the Church's prayer. Sung by monks, clergy, and faithful alike, the psalms accompany every hour of the day, transforming Scripture into living praise. Alongside them, canticles such as the Magnificat and the Benedictus, together with ancient Christian hymns, have remained central to Catholic worship since the earliest centuries of the Church.

Unlike concert music, monastic psalmody is intended to serve prayer. Its restrained melodies, free rhythm, and meditative character allow the sacred texts to take precedence, creating an atmosphere of silence, reflection, and communion with God. This tradition continues to be preserved in monasteries, where the daily chanting of the Divine Office remains an essential expression of monastic life.

title: Latin Chant Against Evil | Vade Retro Satana · St Benedict Prayer of Protection
description:
🕯️ Vade Retro Satana — the ancient prayer of protection of the St Benedict medal, sung in Latin: a plea that the holy cross be our light and our defense against all evil. A prayer of protection and steadfast faith for the night.

▶ Pray the complete Night Prayer, sung (14 min): https://youtu.be/bnDRrfXMOiE
🛡️ Prayers of Protection: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPHKYcOJvvIY
🌙 Compline · Night Prayer: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLKzu2muDqW4mn9V9PGuvL92PwysbAUP19

— LATIN —
Crux sacra sit mihi lux.
Non draco sit mihi dux.
Vade retro, Satana.
Numquam suade mihi vana.
Sunt mala quae libas.
Ipse venena bibas.

— ENGLISH —
May the holy cross be my light.
May the dragon never be my guide.
Begone, Satan!
Never tempt me with your vanities.
What you offer me is evil.
Drink the poison yourself.

A prayer of protection, prayed by the Church for centuries. Light a candle, breathe, and pray.

title: Can Kids Help Heal The Land Of Qook-a-lackas? A Kidventure About the Environment 💚🌿🌳
description:
In this Kidventure episode of Little Kids, Big Hearts, Todd and three new friends, Avery (age 6), Rose (age 8), and Nicholas (almost 7), float off on dandelion parachutes to the magical Land of Qook-a-lackas, where something feels very wrong.

Their friend Qwade, a Qook-a-lacka brought to life by award-winning Broadway actor Wade McCollum, needs their help. The Quilips have been over-picked, the gummy bears are looking tired, the bees are struggling, and the weather has been all mixed up. Together, the kids become nature detectives, piecing together clues and coming up with thoughtful ideas about how to help. From planting new seeds, to giving the garden a rest, to making a Qook-a-lacka promise to try a little better every day, these three kids prove that young people can think big about the world we all share.

Before the adventure, Todd and the kids talk about what they love about the earth, what worries them about the environment, and what small things each of them already does to help. Avery turns a juice box into a unicorn, Rose picks up beach trash with her friends, and Nicholas gives us all a reason to think twice about scorpions.

This episode is imaginative, grounded, and full of genuine wonder.
Perfect for kids ages 2 to 11 and families looking to support social and emotional learning.

In This Episode, Kids Will:
🍀 Travel to the Land of Qook-a-lackas and help to solve an environmental mystery
🍀 Explore the connection between bees, flowers, weather, and the health of the natural world
🍀 Discover that caring for the environment starts with small, meaningful choices
🍀 Learn that it is okay to sit with big, complicated feelings without having all the answers
🍀 Make a Qook-a-lacka promise to practice caring for the planet in their own way

Grown-Ups, You Can Extend the Listening By:
🌱 Asking your child: "What is one small thing you could do today to help take care of the Earth?"
🌱 Talking about the things in your neighborhood you love and want to protect
🌱 Going on a nature walk and looking for signs that plants and animals are connected
🌱 Encouraging your child to try reusing something before throwing it away
🌱 Reminding your child that practice makes progress, and every effort matters

🎭 Special Guest Qook-a-lacka: Wade McCollum is a Broadway actor, filmmaker, singer, composer, writer, director, and co-founder of a neuroscience/music startup. Broadway credits include: Water for Elephants and Floyd Collins. Screen credits include: The Knick, FBI: Most Wanted, and Madame Secretary. Learn more at https//www.wadesong.com.

description:

Sé que muchos me preguntaban cuándo iba a subir este video. La verdad es que me tomó tiempo hacerlo porque necesitaba entender primero qué estaba pasando conmigo y también sentirme emocionalmente lista para contarlo bien y no cansada/ansiosa o llorando jeje.

En este video les explico, por fin, cuál es mi diagnóstico HASTA AHORA cómo empezó todo, qué síntomas tuve, los médicos que visité, los errores que cometí en el camino y todo el proceso que viví hasta llegar a una respuesta.

Mi mayor deseo es que este video no solo responda las preguntas que tantos me han hecho, sino que también pueda ayudar a alguien que esté pasando por algo parecido. Si llevas meses buscando respuestas, si sientes que nadie entiende lo que te está pasando o si todavía no encuentras un diagnóstico, de corazón espero que mi experiencia pueda servirte de alguna manera, así sea para descartar algo.

Si conoces a alguien con inflamación en los párpados, problemas en los ojos, síntomas inexplicables o alguna enfermedad autoinmune, te agradecería muchísimo que le compartieras este video. Nunca sabemos cuándo una historia puede ayudar a otra persona.

Gracias por acompañarme, por tenerme paciencia y por estar aquí. Ojalá este sea el comienzo de mi recuperación… y gracias por caminar este proceso conmigo. ❤️

Los quiero muchísimo, con todo mi corazón
